change: Add live extension preferences for 1-10 overlay tabs, a global shortcut prefix, cycle/open/close keys, and a shortcut enable switch. Defaults remain three tabs with Copilot, Tab, Enter and Escape.

nativeOverlayIntegration.scope: Owned native overlay windows and the real shortcut dispatch thread, using simulated key events that never reach desktop applications. No real chat is opened.
cases: Default Copilot cycling and exact chat dispatch with three tabs
Custom Ctrl+Alt+Space prefix, Down cycling and Right opening across ten tabs
Reduce the tab limit while windows remain open
Disable shortcuts while retaining mouse-accessible tabs
Re-enable with a different prefix; the previous binding no longer expands the tab
Remapped close key dismisses the selected tab
Cycling never gives an overlay foreground focus

additionalCoverage: Lowering the limit moves surviving sessions out of disabled slots and clears stale collapse flags
Dense tabs remain distinct at multiple display sizes and DPI values while expanded messages retain readable height
Settings changes cancel pending chords and balance previously swallowed key releases
Ordinary typing, expired shortcuts and disabled shortcuts pass through
Invalid or duplicate bindings are rejected
A letter used in the prefix can also select its tab without reviving an expired selection
activation: Install locally and reload VS Code once to activate the settings writer. Subsequent preference changes apply live. Helper activation uses the existing idle updater.
